about: Positive and negative vectors for agent-evidence-admission generate. Each case runs the generator on an admit list, for the clients named (default all four), and expects the exit code and the (client, server) pairs refused. Exit 2 means the admit list itself is invalid and nothing is written. The expected directory holds the exact files the first case writes.

cases.why: two versions of one npm stdio server and one remote server render for all four clients
a local script with an absolute command path is exact in Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf
a stdio server with no package cannot be listed in an MCP registry, so the registry refuses it and the other clients still render it
Cursor joins arguments with spaces, so an argument holding a space cannot be matched exactly
the admit list is refused: an empty admit list
the admit list is refused: a digest that is not sha256 and 64 lowercase hex digits
the admit list is refused: a remote URL over plain http
the admit list is refused: a remote URL with a wildcard
the admit list is refused: an entry with both stdio and remote
the admit list is refused: an argument with ${...}, which expands on the user's machine
the admit list is refused: version latest instead of one release
the admit list is refused: one name and version admitted twice
the admit list is refused: one client key naming two servers
the admit list is refused: a name that is not a registry name
